svg.title: rika!
svg.desc: A local-first desktop workspace for students: block notes, planning, study tools, a 3D map of everything in it and a built-in terminal, stored in SQLite. Svelte 5, Python, Tauri. Pictures: Brain view: the whole workspace as one 3D map; Welcome card; Home dashboard.
